The examined primary sections, figures and discussion do not specify or prove the sharp first allowance of 21. No equivalent sharp integer theorem was found in available related searches; this is best-knowledge, not independent priority certification.

value.rationale: The natural resource parameter is the integer number of resets permitted before forced termination. The result locates a precise universal physical regime boundary (20 versus 21 allowed resets), beyond the primary source’s separated example curves. A constructive exact degree-28 positivity certificate is required to control all rates. This is neither a parameter-renaming nor an arbitrary numerical subcase; it answers the first nonmonotonicity question for the published finite-budget model. It does not claim a general theorem for other restarting systems.
